suggestion.title: New jutsu icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the director-approved starter jutsu icon set.

New icon: a single bright crescent of chakra cutting across the frame, with shock rings rippling behind it, matching a high-speed slash that cuts through the air. It replaces the old small scene of a posing ninja, which was hard to read at small sizes.
